title: Product demonstration
passage: How did the demonstration go this morning? A. Take the first exit. B. We received several requests for a trial. C. It starts at ten tomorrow.
passageZh:
今天早上的示範進行得如何？
A. 從第一個出口出去。
B. 我們收到好幾個試用申請。
C. 它明天十點開始。
audioScript: How did the demonstration go this morning? A. Take the first exit. B. We received several requests for a trial. C. It starts at ten tomorrow.
